title: Release change: version 0.1.0 and remove private (DEC-299)
description: The release change DEC-299 reserves: set @opum-ai/glyph to 0.1.0 and remove private, in one PR, nothing else. release.yml is workflow_dispatch only (no push or tag trigger) and its publish job additionally requires a v* tag ref, so merging this change cannot publish anything. No tag, npm publish, visibility flip, npm or GitHub setting, or Trusted Publisher is done by an agent; those are the operator's tier-3 steps, listed in order in GCLI-46's checklist and the operator checklist sent to the leader. Opus review (release and public-surface floor) before landing; promotion to main is the leader's.

acceptanceCriteria.text: package.json reads version 0.1.0 and has no private key (proof: the packaging test asserts both and the diff shows only those two lines)
tests that pinned 0.0.0 now read the version from package.json, so a future bump does not need a test edit (proof: the version tests in test/cli.test.ts derive from package.json and pass)
the packed tarball is named opum-ai-glyph-0.1.0.tgz and the Package gate passes with it (proof: the Package job green on the head; the gate output names the tarball)
merging cannot publish: release.yml has no push, tag or schedule trigger and the publish job requires a v* tag ref (proof: the workflow on: block read at the head, quoted in the PR)
no tag exists and nothing was published (proof: git ls-remote --tags origin empty and npm view @opum-ai/glyph returning not found, both read after the merge)
the change landed with an Opus review at the exact head (proof: review verdict recorded in the task notes)
